outcome: Negative emotions (Self-rating Anxiety Scale - SAS, Self-rating Depression Scale - SDS, Pregnancy Stress Scale - PSS)
Hope levels (HHI, positive attitude to reality and future - T, positive actions taken - P, maintaining close relationship with others - I)
Stress hormone levels in serum (Cortisol - Cor, Adrenaline - ADR, Adrenocorticotropic hormone - ACTH)
cohort: A total of 100 parturients who received cesarean delivery in Zhejiang Provincial People's Hospital from April 2020 to April 2021 were recruited and randomly divided into control and study groups.
finding: Cognitive behavioral stress management intervention for parturients with cesarean section before delivery effectively reduced their negative emotions and stresses, improved their level of hope, and relieved their pain-induced stress.
